market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Rubio is a plausible GOP contender, but the 2028 nomination field is crowded and uncertain. His 2016 campaign underwhelmed, and other prominent Republicans (DeSantis, Haley, Trump Jr.) may be stronger. I estimate his true probability of winning the presidency at around 8%, well below the market-implied 14.1%.
evidence_points: Lost the 2016 GOP primary, failing to gain broad support.
Numerous high-profile potential 2028 rivals (DeSantis, Haley, etc.) dilute his odds.
Presidential elections 4 years out rarely assign double-digit probabilities to non-incumbent party runners.
sources_consulted: Historical presidential betting data on PredictIt
GOP primary polling and expert rankings (as of early 2025)
